rationale: Round 3 surfaced the pivotal issue (board-vote arithmetic and whether labour will pre-commit to act on adverse audit findings) and produced real movement on owner-sacrifice sizing, but the central question—whether Works Council/Union will commit to good-faith renegotiation versus flat defence of status quo on an unfavorable verified finding—remains explicitly unanswered and is now sharply posed for round 4, meaning positions are still actively testing rather than deadlocked.
